The severely withered upper leaf represents end-stage disease from coalescing Septoria lesions causing complete leaf blight.

- Small circular dark lesions scattered across leaf surface
- Progressive yellowing/chlorosis
- End-stage: complete brown necrosis with tissue dropout (holes)
- Spots on lower/older leaves (typical Septoria pattern)
